Q5651.reason: An "as is" clause disclaims implied warranties but not express representations, and the ad and website misdescribed the model year, so Carol can recover.

Q5672.reason: If the man's killing was justified by self-defense, no crime was committed, so the defendant has no derivative accomplice liability; insanity and diminished capacity are personal excuses that don't shield the instigator, and the Wharton Rule doesn't apply.

Q8537.reason: Punishment as a social institution exists independently of the moral reasons offered to justify it, so running the two together would build a justification into the definition.
